critical_architecture_rules: app.html is SOURCE OF TRUTH — always write both app.html AND index.html
NEVER use agents for large edits — use targeted Python string replacement
ALWAYS validate before pushing: python3 scripts/validate.py
seedBetHistory() IIFE must survive every push
renderHomePage() + endSplash() must be in DOMContentLoaded init block
Standalone script AFTER main </script> but BEFORE nav dropdown HTML
WNBA render functions live in STANDALONE script (Script 3) — assigned via window.*
window.showBetPopup / window.closeBetPopup — in IIFE, NOT in _exp array
T(sport, tab): always pass sport='nhl' (not 'hk') so render block fires and ai-class applies
mn8 (WNBA mobile nav) must be inside nba-wnba subp — NOT nba-nba
NEW Session 9: resolve local/origin git divergence before local edits — GitHub Actions pushes directly to origin
NEW Session 9: NEVER put credentials/API keys in client-side JS — fetch server-side in Python, write result to a JSON file the frontend reads (see security_fix_api_key_leak above)
template_literal_safety: NEVER put a literal newline byte inside a JS string literal. Validator catches chr(39)+chr(10)+chr(39) pattern automatically.
block_scoped_function_safety: NEVER declare function foo(){} inside a try/catch/if block — TDZ interaction with outer const causes runtime crash. Caused at least 2 full-app-down incidents this session.
